name: PR416 current-head validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-current-head-validation
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-current-head-validation.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  save-restore-latches:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-current-head-validation
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run isolated save-restore latch assertions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=SaveAndRestoreCarryTheTackleLatches"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

  current-head-census:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: a7f2b77af61c1d0b7138bfdfce21cd1772c91f26
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Install preregistered census helper
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          git show origin/evidence/pr416-mechanism-census:.github/evidence/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          p = Path("src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs")
          s = p.read_text()
          s, ticks_n = re.subn(
              r"private const int Ticks\s*=\s*150_000;",
              "private const int Ticks = 324_000;", s, count=1)
          s, seed_n = re.subn(
              r"(0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978UL,\s*\r?\n\s*0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,)",
              r"\1\n            0x5EED000000000003UL,", s, count=1)
          if ticks_n != 1 or seed_n != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"helper rewrite mismatch ticks={ticks_n} seeds={seed_n}")
          p.write_text(s)
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run current-head census
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=MeasurePr416MechanismCensus"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

  focused-targets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: a7f2b77af61c1d0b7138bfdfce21cd1772c91f26
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run main-relative target set
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-current-focused
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed|Name=BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose|Name=TacklesHappenInComposedPlay|Name=ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-current-focused.trx"             --results-directory artifacts/pr416-current-focused
